shinychat 0.5 and bslib 0.12 offcanvas pick up the same iOS 27 defaults as
the rest of a glass app: refraction, morph, press, and the scroll edge.
Pass `theme = glass_theme()` to `page_chat()`. An embedded `chat_ui()`
inside any glass page uses the same CSS.

```r
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(shinyglass)
library(shinychat)

ui <- page_chat(
  "Glass notes",
  id = "chat",
  theme = glass_theme(),
  placeholder = "Message",
  sidebar = chat_sidebar(history = TRUE, open = "always"),
  toolbar = toolbar(
    toolbar_input_button("open_sources", "Sources")
  )
)
```

The header, history sidebar, and drawer are glass chrome. User bubbles are
tinted pills. The composer is a floating pill, like the iOS 27 Messages
bar, and grows a fade when the transcript sits underneath it. Thinking
rows, tool cards, citation chips (`<shiny-aside>`), attachment and text
previews, toolbars, and the slash-command menu use the menu surface so
they stay readable on the wallpaper.

`offcanvas()` panels use the same material. They still slide with
Bootstrap's transform. A separate scale grows the panel from the trigger
when morph is on. Scrolling the panel body fades the header. Reduced
motion skips that scale. Reduced transparency, increased contrast, and
forced colors turn the lens off, as they do for other chrome.

```r
observeEvent(input$open_sources, {
  show_offcanvas(offcanvas(
    id = "sources_panel",
    title = "Sources",
    placement = "end",
    "Citations stay in this panel."
  ))
})
```

Harbor notes is a core demo, with the dusk wallpaper behind the glass:

```r
shiny::runApp(system.file("examples/shinychat-glass", package = "shinyglass"))
```

With no API key the reply is a local script. It streams a thinking panel,
a short answer, a citation chip, and a tide-table tool card.
`GEMINI_API_KEY` (or `GOOGLE_API_KEY`) switches that session to
`ellmer::chat_google_gemini()` with Gemini Flash (`gemini-3.7-flash`,
or `SHINYGLASS_CHAT_MODEL`). The system prompt keeps answers short and
on shinyglass, Shiny, and R. A public session allows 8 messages of at
most 400 characters. If the API errors or returns a quota response
(429), the demo shows a short notice and continues with the local script.
The key is never written to the log or the page.
History uses `history_options(store = "memory", title = NULL)`, so nothing
is written to disk and no model is asked for a title. The sidebar starts
open on desktop and collapses into the page menu on a phone.
